title: Validation case: prohibition of remote gambling services (based on US – Gambling, DS285)

answers.name: Prohibition of remote supply of gambling and betting services
answers.description: Federal and state laws prohibit the cross-border (remote) supply of gambling and betting services.
answers.sector: Other recreational services (W/120 10.D, CPC 964), as interpreted in DS285

notes.ma_zero_quota: The Appellate Body treated the prohibition as a 'zero quota' under XVI:2(a) and (c).
notes.x_alternative: Antigua's proposed alternative (consultations) was not a reasonably available alternative.
notes.ch_discrimination: Domestic remote betting on horse racing appeared permitted (Interstate Horseracing Act), so the US did not meet the chapeau.
